system.description:
Your strength is truly monumental — you heft hundreds of pounds with ease and crush bone in a single blow, hammering down any opponent of lesser power.

Vigor lets you use the Bomb in challenges of strength. The Bomb (a closed fist with the thumb sticking up) beats Rock and Paper, ties other Bombs and loses to Scissors; you need not use it, but you must state before a Physical Challenge that you are able to. Vigor costs nothing. It requires you to rely on your own strength; an opponent may defend with stamina or speed, but that does not stop you from using the Bomb.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
